rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a dead human body.

example.english: The police found a corpse in the back alley.
example.traditional: 警方喺後巷發現一具屍體。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 hai2 hau6 hong2 faat3 jin6 jat1 geoi6 si1 tai2

rows.note: A speaker uses this when emphasizing the dead or gruesome nature of the body.

example.english: I screamed when I opened the door and saw a gruesome corpse.
example.traditional: 我一開門就見到一具血淋淋嘅死屍，嚇到喊出聲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 hoi1 mun4 zau6 gin3 dou2 jat1 geoi6 hyut3 lam4 lam4 ge3 sei2 si1 haak3 dou2 haam3 ceot1 seng1
